verdict.rationale: Docs mention employee onboarding requiring federal and state tax information (docs-63, docs-37) and company-level bank account setup (docs-60/2), which touches part of the story, but there is no mention of I-9 collection or a dedicated self-serve new-hire flow bundling W-4, I-9, and bank details together. Most evidence concerns the Embedded Payroll API for partners rather than a direct ops-facing onboarding checklist. missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection, a documented self-serve new-hire onboarding flow (vs. company-level setup), employee bank-account collection step, independent/hands-on confirmation the flow works end-to-end.
